remarks: Renovated 5 bedroom 5 bath Colonial within walking distance to town. High end kitchen and baths, study, open floor plan and 3 sets of french doors open to a flat professionally landscaped yard, spacious terrace and outdoor fireplace. Optional first or second floor master bedrooms, 3 car garage, finished lower level with au pair suite, family room with fireplace and private terrace. This home is not to be missed! Preferred longer lease.
